data.name: AlAmina
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, AlAmina is the name of the Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) wife, Khadija bint Khuwaylid, who was his first wife and the first to believe in him. The name AlAmina symbolizes the protection and support she provided to the Prophet (pbuh) in the early days of his prophethood.
